name: guest-subtree
//: SCOPED sync for working inside someone else's Roblox project.
This maps ONLY your own subtree. It deliberately does not map
a broad mapping plus Rojo's default sync behaviour can delete their
instances that have no counterpart on disk.
Before using: replace YourName below with your actual folder name,
and confirm with the project owner that these three folders are yours
to own. Then create them in Studio ONCE, by hand, before serving.
Never point `rojo serve` at this without reading guest/README.md.
